subject: Development track: clarity, expectations and 30-day checkpoints
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwo od.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Development track: clarity, expectations and 30-day checkpoints

Hi Rishi / Neha / Rohan,

Following up on last week's calibration, I want to document a short, focused coaching approach for Rohan that gives clear expectations and measurable checkpoints over the next 30 days. The goal is to provide a documented support plan (not a PIP) with weekly touchpoints so Rohan can get back to expected performance.

Key items I'm proposing: 
- Objective: Improve PR review turnaround, ship predictable work, and increase cross-team communication.
- Success criteria: average PR review <48 hours; two on-time deliveries of assigned sprint stories; proactive stakeholder updates twice weekly.
- Checkpoints: weekly 1:1s (EOD Fridays) and a formal 30-day review with Rishi + Neha.
- Support: shadowing sessions, prioritized ticket queue, and a brief skills resource packet (attached).

Rishi — please confirm you can run the weekly check-ins and own the short-term delivery plan. Neha — please advise on documentation we should maintain and any HR guardrails to follow so this remains a development-first conversation.

Rohan — I'm including you to make sure this matches what we discussed and to surface any blockers that would prevent you from meeting these goals. We'll adjust cadence if needed, but clarity up front will help.

Attachments: 2026-11-15_ev_coaching_plan_template.xlsx (coaching plan template), 2026-11-15_supporting_examples.pdf (examples of expected deliverables)

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Engineering Managers
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Development track: clarity, expectations and 30-day checkpoints

Thanks Evelyn — I can take point on the weekly check-ins. I reviewed the suggested success criteria and they look reasonable. I'll draft the sprint-level plan and a prioritized ticket list today and share in the 1:1.

A couple of quick notes from my side:
- Rohan's recent time on the infra migration distracted him from feature work; I'll re-slice his tasks to avoid overlap for the next 30 days.
- I suggest an initial shadowing pair with Priya for review best practices (she's agreed to a short session).

I'll populate the attached template and have an initial update by EOD Thursday.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Engineer (Infra)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Development track: clarity, expectations and 30-day checkpoints

Thanks for laying this out. I'm on board with the plan and appreciate the clarity. A couple things that would help me: 
- If some of the infra tasks can be reassigned for the next sprint, that would let me focus on the delivery items.
- Can we set the weekly 1:1 for Friday mornings at 9am PT? That time generally works for me.

I'll review the attachments and fill in my portion of the template by Wednesday.

Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Software Engineer
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Development track: clarity, expectations and 30-day checkpoints

Thanks all — good plan. A few HR notes to keep this development-first and compliant: 
- Document all coaching conversations in the shared HR folder (link above) and keep notes factual.
- Avoid language that implies disciplinary action; this is a supportive improvement plan.
- If at any point we consider escalation, loop in People Ops before changing the plan.

I'll create a short HR checklist and upload it to the Drive doc by EOD Monday. Also confirming it's fine to schedule the Friday 9am PT recurring 1:1.

Neha Kapoor
People Partner
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Development track: clarity, expectations and 30-day checkpoints

Quick 30-day wrap: thanks to Rishi and Rohan for consistent updates. Summary: 
- PR turnaround average improved from ~72h to ~40h over the 30 days.
- Two sprint stories were delivered on time and we saw clearer stakeholder updates.
- Remaining area: proactive flagging of scope creep; Rishi will keep pairing sessions weekly for two more weeks.

Next steps:
- Rishi & Rohan to finalize a 60-day sustain plan and we will re-evaluate at the next 1:1.
- Neha: upload the final coaching notes to HR folder (HR-Case-#4452).

Thanks all — I consider this development track successful so far; no further action needed unless regressions appear.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Engineering Managers
Redwood Inference
